format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this backdrop, like "valley". It matches the file name.

seed.description: Change this number for another painting of the same description.

tile.description: How many pixels of the picture make one tile of the game.

width.description: How many tiles wide a layer is before it repeats.

id.description: A name for this layer, used once in this backdrop, like "hills".

kind.description: How it is painted: "flat" is a band, then "hills", "mountains" or "clouds".

color.description: The colour of the layer, as # and six digits, like #afd472.

height.description: How high it reaches, in tiles above the level's bottom edge.

drift.description: How much it moves with the level: 0 stays still on the screen like far mountains, 1 moves with it.

layers.description: The layers, back to front. Each stands on the bottom edge of the level and repeats sideways.

id.description: A name for this prop, used once in this backdrop, like "tree-1".

figure.description: Which figure stands there, by id, like "tree".

pose.description: Which of the figure's poses. Left out means its first.

layer.description: The layer it stands on and moves with, by id, like "hills".

x.description: Where the middle of its foot is, in tiles from the level's left edge.

up.description: How far its foot is above the level's bottom edge, in tiles.

props.description: Figures that stand on a layer, like trees on hills. Write [] for none.
